title: Roundcube Webmail before 1.6.19 and 1.7.x before 1.7.4 contains an authorization bypass in add_to_group() and…
description: Roundcube Webmail versions before 1.6.19 and 1.7.x before 1.7.4 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability in the add_to_group() and remove_from_group() functions. This flaw allows an authenticated user of the SQL address book to manipulate contact groups by adding or removing contacts belonging to other users without proper verification.
